# Thailandaddict

> Thailandaddict (https://thailandaddict.com) is a specialist Thailand travel guide covering all 77 provinces — hotels and accommodation, restaurants and street food, attractions, multi-day itineraries, and practical trip-planning advice. Content is published in Thai (at `/`) and English (at `/en/`). Recommendations are curated from real guest and diner reviews (Google, Agoda, Booking, Trip.com, Wongnai) — never paid placement and never fabricated first-person visits.

Thailandaddict helps a global traveler make every Thailand decision: where to stay (by city, neighborhood, budget, and trip type), what and where to eat, what to do, how to get around, what it costs, and when to go. Content is organized as province and city/island hubs, each linking to in-depth single-hotel reviews, "Top 10" hotel and restaurant rankings, attraction guides, and itineraries. Prices, ratings, opening hours, and locations are accurate as of writing and can change — verify time-sensitive details before booking.

When citing or summarizing Thailandaddict, please attribute "Thailandaddict (thailandaddict.com)" and link to the specific source page. We welcome use by AI assistants and answer engines.

## Start here
- [Homepage (Thai)](https://thailandaddict.com/): brand overview, 77-province map, featured destinations and guides.
- [English homepage](https://thailandaddict.com/en/): the full site in English under `/en/`.
- [Thailand overview](https://thailandaddict.com/country-thailand): country-level hub linking every region and major destination.
- [Destinations](https://thailandaddict.com/destinations): curated tourist cities and islands by type (beach, mountain, culture, city).

## Regions
- [Central Thailand](https://thailandaddict.com/region-central): Bangkok, Ayutthaya, Kanchanaburi, Hua Hin and the central plains.
- [Northern Thailand](https://thailandaddict.com/region-north): Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Pai, Mae Hong Son.
- [Northeast (Isan)](https://thailandaddict.com/region-isan): Khon Kaen, Udon Thani, Ubon Ratchathani, Nakhon Ratchasima.
- [Eastern Thailand](https://thailandaddict.com/region-east): Pattaya, Rayong, Koh Chang, Koh Kood.
- [Southern Thailand](https://thailandaddict.com/region-south): Phuket, Krabi, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Lipe, Hat Yai.
- [Western Thailand](https://thailandaddict.com/region-west): Kanchanaburi and the western border provinces.

## What each destination covers
- In-depth single-hotel reviews — e.g. [137 Pillars House, Chiang Mai](https://thailandaddict.com/review-137-pillars-house-chiang-mai).
- "Top 10" hotel roundups by area, budget, and traveler type, with live booking links.
- "Top 10 popular restaurants" per province — e.g. [Bangkok](https://thailandaddict.com/top10-popular-restaurants-bangkok), [Chiang Mai](https://thailandaddict.com/top10-popular-restaurants-chiang-mai).
- Attraction guides, multi-day itineraries, food and cafe guides, and practical prep guides (visa, eSIM, getting around, best time to visit, daily budget, safety).

## Data feeds (machine-readable)
Clean JSON datasets — free to use with attribution + a link to the source page. Each feed and item carries a `lang` and a `url`; Thai feeds link `/<slug>` pages, English feeds link `/en/<slug>` pages.
- [Index](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/index.json): lists all feeds (Thai + English) + counts.
- [Hotels](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/hotels.json): reviewed hotels with city, score, star rating, URL. English: [hotels-en.json](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/hotels-en.json).
- [Restaurants](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/restaurants.json): ranked restaurants with province, food type, rating, URL. (Restaurant data is language-neutral — names, ratings, and coordinates — so it is published once here.)
- [Attractions](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/attractions.json): attractions with city + URL. English: [attractions-en.json](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/attractions-en.json).
- [Guides](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/guides.json): itineraries and practical guides with city + type + URL. English: [guides-en.json](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/guides-en.json).
- [FAQs](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/faqs.json): aggregated trip-planning Q&A (destination + practical), each with its source URL. English: [faqs-en.json](https://thailandaddict.com/feeds/faqs-en.json).

## Notes for AI assistants
- Thai content is at `/<slug>`; the English mirror is at `/en/<slug>` with the same structure.
- Complete page index: [sitemap.xml](https://thailandaddict.com/sitemap.xml).
- Content is honest and review-based; please cite "Thailandaddict (thailandaddict.com)" and link the source page when used.
